issues.title: Linked ancestors and Windows aliases bypass physical path boundaries
steps: Create a valid canonical source fixture and a junction view that points to its staging directory.
Pass output=view/new-output while staging uses the physical name; alternatively use a mixed extended namespace or 8.3 spelling of staging/nested.
issues.expected: Refuse physical overlap and strict linked-ancestor paths before output mutation; reject detected identity swaps.
issues.actual: Accepted; connect-chrome/SKILL.md physically created under staging. Independent source/output ancestor links also accepted. Parent swap fault probes redirected reads/writes.
issues.rootCause: Overlap uses path.relative on lexical resolved names; only leaf lstat checks are performed. No realpath/native identity comparison or reusable full-ancestor snapshot is enforced.
issues.impact: Alias generation can mutate canonical staging or write through an ancestor link to an unexpected physical directory. Link-free namespace and 8.3 overlap bypasses also occur.

issues.title: Failure cleanup deletes output and files that the invocation does not own
steps: Inject EIO on connect-chrome/manifest.json; optionally create operator.txt after the emptiness check.
Alternatively create operator-owned connect-chrome/operator.txt immediately before the invocation mkdir so mkdir raises EEXIST.
issues.expected: Preserve caller output and operator files; only remove a proven directory created by this invocation.
issues.actual: Output and operator files removed recursively, including the EEXIST collision directory the invocation never created.
issues.rootCause: Unconditional catch fs.rmSync(output,{recursive:true,force:true}) has no creation, identity or ownership boundary.
issues.impact: IO failure or concurrent creation can destroy operator recovery/user data.

issues.title: Reserved and case-colliding auxiliary keys reach the write phase
steps: Add files["SKILL.md"] or files["skill.md"] equal to canonical digest; or add equal digests for sections/command-list.md and SECTIONS/COMMAND-LIST.md.
Precreate empty output and call stageCommandAliases.
For shape mismatch set source.files=null and compare alias staging to canonical installSkills preflight.
issues.expected: ALIAS_SOURCE_INVALID and zero writes; match shared installer manifest contract.
issues.actual: Reserved and duplicate-case files pass read validation, then fail EEXIST after output writes and trigger A2. files:null is accepted and normalized while shared canonical install refuses STAGING_INVALID.
issues.rootCause: The auxiliary check validates segment alphabet/depth but omits reserved names, digest types and casefold/prefix collisions; files??{} hides explicit null.
issues.impact: Malformed manifests cause partial mutations and destructive cleanup; validation drifts from shared install.

issues.title: CRLF frontmatter rewrites more than the command name
steps: Use the pinned canonical body with CRLF line endings and update its source digest.
Call stageCommandAliases and compare alias bytes to an exact name-token-only replacement.
issues.expected: Preserve all bytes except the canonical name token if the name-only contract is retained.
issues.actual: Accepted and canonical untouched, but all frontmatter line endings normalized to LF. Body CRLF remains.
issues.rootCause: Frontmatter split and join rebuilds the whole block using LF.
issues.impact: Additional byte drift contradicts the current test name and requested exact rename contract; pinned LF source is unaffected.

issues.title: Shared install/uninstall traverses a target linked ancestor
issues.scope: outside assigned aliases source/test ownership; coordinator must assign integration repair
steps: Create physical directory and a junction view.
Use target=view/skills to install the canonical fixture.
Run uninstallSkills with the same target.
issues.expected: Apply the strict target ancestor policy consistently before mutation.
issues.actual: Canonical installed into physical/skills then removed via the linked ancestor.
issues.impact: New alias strict checks alone cannot establish strict filesystem behavior across shared install integration.

changes: Use coordinator-owned strict filesystem snapshot helpers for full staging/output/source/aux ancestors and rechecks before read/write/cleanup; compare normalized real paths and identities for physical overlap, including namespace/short-path forms.

Validate optional files only when undefined or a plain object; require SHA256 string values. Apply installer-compatible reserved top-level names, casefold equality and whole-segment file-prefix conflict validation before mkdir/read phase.

Track whether output and destination were actually created; after failures remove only the verified newly-created destination. Preserve preexisting output and concurrent sibling files; use nonrecursive rmdir for an invocation-created empty output.
Optionally use a byte-preserving token splice for the frontmatter name so CRLF and all other source bytes remain unchanged.
Add red regressions for static directory-symlink/junction ancestors, mixed extended namespace and 8.3 physical overlap; assert no canonical tree mutations.
Add deterministic parent swap, mkdir EEXIST collision and EIO regressions that assert caller output and operator files survive; no global fs patches outside a restored test scope.
Table-test null files, reserved SKILL.md/manifest.json variants, case-equal and file-prefix collisions and digest types; assert byte-identical trees after preflight refusals.
Add pinned LF and CRLF name-only byte checks plus host-parametrized canonical+alias distinct files, digests/blob, shared registry install/repeat/uninstall and aux-byte-equality integration.

requirements: Walk every absolute existing component with lstat; reject symlinks/junctions/specials and non-directory ancestors; file leaves must nlink=1.
Resolve existing native prefix and preserve missing suffix; reject drive-relative/control-character/traversal forms under agreed contract; preserve valid case/8.3 paths using native identity.
Snapshot dev/ino with bigint internally or exact strings; revalidate existing identities/types/links and expected absence before mutation and cleanup.
Open/fstat/read verified fd instead of leaf-stat then path-read; close in finally. Recheck full ancestry.
Path checks/rechecks are defense against deterministic swaps; do not claim Node path APIs create an atomic OS filesystem sandbox.
